title: Dell reports Q3 revenue up 103% YoY to $54.94B, above $49.32B est., and raises its annual revenue and profit forecasts for the third time this year (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: Dell reports Q3 revenue up 103% YoY to $54.94B, above $49.32B est., and raises its annual revenue and profit forecasts for the third time this year — Dell Technologies (DELL.N) on Tuesday raised its annual revenue and profit forecasts for the third time this year after record quarterly results …
